title: How to put on a male condom
answer: First check the expiry date and make sure the packet is not torn. Open it gently with your fingers, never with teeth, scissors or a blade. Put the condom on when the penis is hard and before it touches your partner's genitals. Check that the rim is on the outside so it rolls down easily. Pinch the tip to squeeze out air, then roll it all the way down to the base. If you start putting it on the wrong way, throw it away and use a new one.
